# Security assessment coverage

- Scope: existing application source, templates, JavaScript, configuration, Maven build, Docker deployment and Oracle initialization scripts; not a diff review. `.github/agents` excluded. No application changes or tests executed.
- Maven `dependency:tree` completed successfully (exit 0); 104 direct/transitive resolved artifacts, including runtime, optional development and test dependencies. Tree and inventory retained. Dependency declaration locations for transitive artifacts use the depth-1 ancestor selected by Maven. Some runtime artifacts appear under the test starter due to Maven conflict mediation.
- GitHub CLI advisory requests failed authentication in all four batches. Retried all 104 dependencies using unauthenticated curl against GitHub Global Security Advisories, batches of 30/30/30/14. All four requests succeeded; one page per batch, no next links. 85 unique nonwithdrawn API advisories returned, matched against package names and version ranges. Raw advisory responses and query status retained. No vulnerability identifiers were inferred or invented.
- CVE findings confirm dependency version matches only, not exploit reachability. Advisory preconditions and dependency scopes are retained; test-only packages do not imply runtime exposure. Maven plugin dependencies, Docker base images, Oracle server binaries and OS packages are outside this Maven advisory enumeration; no SBOM/image/database binary scan performed. Advisory database completeness and unauthenticated rate limits remain external limitations.
- CWE scan coverage and findings will be appended after each sequential category scan. NOT_FOUND means no confirmed instance in reviewed code, not proof of absence.

- File/path: all 5 rules reviewed sequentially; 0 FOUND / 5 NOT_FOUND. No application filesystem or XML parser input sink; BLOB storage, MIME allowlist, authentication, limits and default nosniff considered. Content validation is permissive, but no dangerous-type execution path confirmed.

- Injection: all 12 rules reviewed; 1 FOUND (DOM XSS in filename validation errors, requiring file-selection/drop interaction), 11 NOT_FOUND. Parameterized SQL and escaped server templates considered; deployment-environment SQL interpolation not reported without a lower-trust control path.

- Memory safety: all 15 rules reviewed; 0 FOUND / 15 NOT_FOUND. Managed Java/JavaScript, guarded preview copy and ImageIO cleanup reviewed. Resource lifetime rule remains relevant, so category was not marked wholly inapplicable. JVM/native dependency implementation internals not audited.

- Code quality: all 16 rules reviewed; 1 FOUND (CWE-789 public gallery eagerly materializes all database BLOBs without an aggregate bound), 15 NOT_FOUND. Finding requires sufficient stored data/concurrency; no runtime exhaustion attempted. Upload size/pixel checks and resource cleanup considered.

- Credentials/secrets: all 5 rules reviewed; 0 FOUND / 5 NOT_FOUND (medium confidence). Required external credentials, BCrypt, placeholder examples, least-privilege schema grants and existing operation logs considered. All secret/password values masked in generated explanations; no secrets persisted. External runtime permissions/log sinks and authentication audit retention not verified.

- Concurrency/synchronization: all 6 rules reviewed; 0 FOUND / 6 NOT_FOUND. Spring singleton fields, request-local state, transaction boundaries, UUID IDs, client async flow and startup sequencing considered. No stress test or runtime concurrency validation performed.

- Completed six CWE categories in the requested order, exactly one at a time: file/path, injection, memory, code quality, credentials, concurrency. Total 59 rules: 2 FOUND / 57 NOT_FOUND. Each rule appears once in its category wrapper with original severity/storyPoint/description; NOT_FOUND evidence is empty by schema. Assessment files were written directly because write_assessment_result is unavailable. No application code, tests, staging, commits, rendering or merges performed.

- Additional boundaries: templates also load Bootstrap 5.3.0 from jsDelivr; this CDN-only frontend dependency is not represented by the Maven dependency tree and was not queried as an npm package. No claims of complete frontend/CDN advisory coverage. Full source/configuration inspection includes all three templates, production Java/JavaScript, application properties, POM, Dockerfile, Compose and Oracle startup scripts. Skill/assessment automation files are not application runtime code. Existing parent-staged report artifacts were left untouched.
- Validation: parsed every output JSON, checked all 59 CWE rule identifiers/names/severities/story points/descriptions against skill definitions, verified empty NOT_FOUND evidence, checked FOUND source paths/line bounds and CVE ID uniqueness. 85 CVE findings, 2 CWE findings, 57 CWE NOT_FOUND entries.
